guidance.summary: Maintain EBITDA margin of 27% for the current financial year
guidance.speaker: Damodar Bhattad
guidance.quote: As of now, we maintain the EBITDA margin of 27% what we have guided for the current year , because it is a composition of products which we sell.

guidance.summary: Grow revenue at more than 15% year-on-year in years to come
guidance.speaker: Manoj Jain
guidance.quote: So, we are confident that we will have steady growth of more than 15% in years to come.

guidance.summary: Order inflow of INR 27,000 crores plus for FY26
guidance.speaker: Manoj Jain
guidance.quote: revenue growth more than 15 %, EBITDA margin definitely more than 27 %, order inflow INR 27,000 crore s plus , R&D investment although we told INR 1 , 600 crore , but I am confident we may cross INR 1 , 700 but at least INR 1 , 600 plus definitely we are going to be there , CAPEX INR 1 , 000 crore and defense non - defense business of 90 to 10 .

guidance.speaker: Manoj Jain
guidance.quote: Definitely , export opportunities are there in all the areas of BEL ’s operation and we are doing a focused attempt to increase our export turnover from pre sently 3% to 4% to 5% in near future and overall 10% in a long - term.

guidance.summary: Cross 10% of turnover through non-defense leads in near future
guidance.speaker: Manoj Jain
guidance.quote: So , put together , these we are confident that in near future we will try to cross 10 % of our turnover through these non - defense leads.

guidance.summary: Long-term aim to make non-defense business 15% and beyond
guidance.speaker: Manoj Jain
guidance.quote: Certainly , as you also told , right now our non - defense is around 6%, 7% type of thing only , which we want to definitely cross ( +10% ) in near future and long - term our aim is to make it 15 % and beyond.

guidance.summary: Aim for minimum INR 1,000 crore next year onwards from data center business
guidance.speaker: Manoj Jain
guidance.quote: O ur aim is minimum INR ( +1,000 ) crore next year onwards from data center type of business .

guidance.summary: Minimum 20% year-on-year growth investment in R&D
guidance.speaker: Manoj Jain
guidance.quote: R&D investments we are going to increase in a very sizable way , minimum 20 % year - on - year growth investment we have committed now .

guidance.summary: Revenue growth of more than 15% for FY26
